description: This file implements encryption handling within the PDFsharp library, specifically managing encryption versions 1, 2, and 4 for PDF documents. It includes methods for setting encryption modes, preparing encryption data for saving, and validating passwords. It also handles object-level encryption and decryption using RC4 and AES algorithms, supporting different revision and version schemes as per PDF standards.

classes.name: PdfEncryptionV1To4
classes.description: A class implementing encryption handling for PDF versions 1, 2, and 4 within the PDFsharp library. It manages encryption settings, key derivation, password validation, and object-level encryption/decryption, supporting RC4 and AES algorithms depending on the version.

methods.name: SetEncryptionToV1
methods.description: Configures the encryption settings for PDF version 1, using RC4 with a 40-bit key.

methods.name: SetEncryptionToV2
methods.description: Configures the encryption settings for PDF version 2, allowing variable key length (default 40 bits).

methods.name: SetEncryptionToV4UsingRC4
methods.description: Configures encryption with RC4 and 128-bit key, supporting PDF version 1.5.

methods.name: SetEncryptionToV4UsingAES
methods.description: Configures encryption with AES and 128-bit key, supporting PDF version 1.6.

methods.name: InitializeFromLoadedSecurityHandler
methods.description: Initializes encryption parameters based on an already loaded security handler from a PDF document.

methods.name: PrepareEncryptionForSaving
methods.description: Prepares the encryption dictionary with current settings before saving the document.

methods.name: ValidatePassword
methods.description: Validates a user-supplied password against the encryption parameters.

methods.name: EncryptForEnteredObject
methods.description: Encrypts data bytes for a specific PDF object using the current encryption scheme.

methods.name: DecryptForEnteredObject
methods.description: Decrypts data bytes for a specific PDF object using the current encryption scheme.

methods.name: EnterObject
methods.description: Sets the current object context for object-level encryption/decryption.

methods.name: EncryptForEnteredObjectUsingRC4
methods.description: Encrypts data bytes for an object using RC4 algorithm with the computed object key.

methods.name: DecryptForEnteredObjectUsingRC4
methods.description: Decrypts data bytes for an object also using RC4, as symmetric encryption.

methods.name: EncryptForEnteredObjectUsingAES
methods.description: Encrypts data bytes for an object using AES encryption, prepending IV.

methods.name: DecryptForEnteredObjectUsingAES
methods.description: Decrypts data bytes for an object using AES, extracting IV.
